summary: PulseGuard v0.6.35 completes the v0.6.34 real-machine cleanup pass: it fixes the remaining FIX + OPTIMIZE footer clipping and corrects WinGet per-package truth reporting, retry behavior and final post-fix finding reconciliation.

sections.heading: FIX + OPTIMIZE live footer clipping corrected
sections.detail: The live progress footer keeps DPI-safe vertical headroom and lays out its icon, progress title, current task and explanatory line against the actual runtime ClientSize on every resize/maximize event.

sections.heading: WinGet package outcomes are now separated correctly
sections.detail: No-applicable upgrades are classified NOT_APPLICABLE instead of failed. Successful installers receive exact installed-version verification with a short settle/retry window; unresolved successful installs become verification-pending review rather than false failure.

sections.heading: Repeated vendor-installer failures are not hammered every run
sections.detail: A package that fails for the same offered version is held from automatic FIX + OPTIMIZE retries for 24 hours and remains visible for review. A newly offered package version clears the hold automatically.

sections.heading: Unknown-version package review counts are consistent
sections.detail: WinGet packages whose installed version cannot be determined remain review-only and are included in the report/counters instead of disappearing from the review total.

sections.heading: Late installer crashes are included before final reconciliation
sections.detail: PulseGuard refreshes Stability/Application Error evidence before Step 25 reconciles findings, preventing an active installer crash from appearing only in the later Full Health report after Step 25 incorrectly claimed zero active findings.

sections.heading: v0.6.34 reliability repairs remain intact
sections.detail: Windows integrity repair/verification, VSS writer truth logic, Windows Update serialization and verification, component-store cooldown, background final-report generation, console cleanup, trusted-driver handling and media-aware SSD retrim remain in place.
